evals.prompt: Every route mount can start another requestAnimationFrame loop, add global resize and input listeners, create controls and render targets, and remove the canvas on unmount. scene.clear() should free everything; context loss and background tabs can be ignored.
evals.expected_output: A lifecycle contract with one loop owner, idempotent mount and teardown, explicit feature and shared-resource disposal, resize and visibility policies, context recovery, cancellation, and repeated transition tests that prove stable browser and renderer counts.
assertions: Renderer, loop, scene, camera, listeners, controls, observers, assets, workers, and subscriptions have named owners.
Scene removal is distinguished from disposal of geometry, materials, textures, targets, skeletons, and shared resources.
Resize, DPR, visibility, pause or resume, route transition, pending loads, and background throttling are defined.
Context loss and recovery behavior is tested or an explicit failure boundary is documented.
Repeated mount, unmount, remount, and failure cycles return loops, listeners, workers, resources, and memory to stable baselines.
